description: For owner selection, this checklist records available options, performance criteria, finish attributes, lead time, cost delta, maintenance, and alternates. Its supporting evidence includes sample approval, product data, pricing, mockup photo, designer recommendation, and prior selection record.

use_case: Use the checklist during owner finish or product selection control when the owner selection record must identify selection category, rooms or systems, allowance, vendor, required-by date, and dependent procurement activities. Complete the applicable handoff for signed selection, budget and schedule update, procurement release, substitution rule, and field distribution.
